items: 2 teaspoons salt (plus more for the pasta cooking water)
1 lemon (zested and juiced (zest it before you juice it))
400 g dried pasta of your choice ((14oz), 500g/18oz fresh pasta)
½ cup grated parmesan cheese (plus more to serve)
½ cup reserved pasta water (plus more as needed)
A handful of fresh basil leaves (chopped)
A handful of fresh mint leaves (chopped)

steps: Cook the courgettes.Thinly slice your zucchini and garlic cloves, then set a wide, high-sided skillet or frying pan over medium-low heat. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, the sliced zucchini, 1 teaspoon salt, sliced garlic, and 1 teaspoon chilli flakes.Cook, stirring occasionally, until the courgettes are super soft and starting to break down. This will take about 15 minutes.

Cook your pasta.You can do this while the courgettes cook. Set a large pot of water over high heat, add a big pinch of salt, then bring to a boil. Once boiling, add your pasta and cook it according to the packet instructions. Depending on the pasta you use, this will take around 8 to 10 minutes. If you drain your pasta, remember to scoop out at least 1 cup of cooking water before you do.

Toss the pasta with the courgettes.Once your pasta is al dente (cooked, with a little bite to it), use tongs or a slotted spoon to transfer it directly into the pan with the courgettes, along with ½ cup of the pasta cooking water. Toss the pasta through the courgettes.

Create the sauce.Scatter the grated parmesan, half the basil and mint, and the lemon zest on top. Leave it for 30 seconds so the parmesan can start to melt into the sauce, then toss vigorously to create a silky, luxurious sauce.Add more pasta water, a splash at a time, if needed, to make your glossy sauce.

Finish and serve.Add 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, the fish sauce if you're using it, and a good grind of black pepper, then toss again. Taste, then add a little more lemon or salt as needed.Divide the pasta between plates and finish with the remaining herbs, more parmesan, and another good grind of black pepper. Serve right away.
